extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New: titles can be hidden from Continue Watching. A new switch, Allow Hiding from Continue Watching on the Home Screen page, off by default, adds Hide to the press and hold menu of the Continue Watching pop up. A hidden film or episode stays out of its row until it is played again; on a Next Up row it hides the show until any of its episodes is played. Switching it off shows them all again. Nothing is written to the library. Changed: Next Up is now a row of library items, so a press and hold on it opens the same menu as the rows above (Resume, Mark as watched, Mark as unwatched, and Hide when that is on), and a click plays as theirs do. Its shows now run A to Z.
